production.note: Calendar years. Quote (Koenigsegg model page): "Made in only 7 examples Built between 2014 and 2015". Asphalte.ch (asphalte-one1, J-C Etter, 3 March 2014) at the Geneva launch: "The One:1 production run will be 5 cars, in addition to the development car presented on the Geneva autoshow stand."

body.note: Quote: "Two-door, two-seater with detachable roof" (removable roof panel, as on the Jesko record).

configuration.note: Quote: "Koenigsegg aluminum 5,0L V8, 4 valves per cylinder, double overhead camshafts with flex-fuel capability"

displacementL.note: "5,0L"; Koenigsegg gives bore 92 mm and stroke 95.25 mm but no cc figure. The model page says "5.0 Liters V8 displacement".

fuel.note: Flex-fuel ("Flex fuel capability"); runs on gasoline or E85.

drivetrain.note: Quote (Asphalte.ch): "The task to channel this biblical torque to the rear wheels is entrusted to a 7-gear twin clutch gearbox." Koenigsegg lists an "Electronic differential".

transmission.note: Quote: "Specially developed 7-speed dual clutch, 1 input shaft transmission with paddle-shift"

powerHp.note: Quote (Koenigsegg technical specifications): "Power output: 1 MW at 7500 rpm – rpm limiter @ 8250 rpm". 1,000 kW x 1.34102 = 1,341 hp. Koenigsegg's model page (koenigsegg-one1) also prints "1 MW Output" and "1,360 hp"; 1 MW is 1,360 PS, so the "1,360 hp" is the metric figure. Koenigsegg does not state the fuel for the 1 MW rating; its other cars reach their maximum on E85. Unlike the Jesko and Agera R records (stored "as published" because no kW figure was available), a kW rating exists here, so it is converted per the guide; powerStandard is DIN PS (metric rating).

weightLb.note: Koenigsegg curb weight (step 1): 1,360 kg x 2.20462 = 2,998 lb. Quote: "Curb weight 1360 kg (complete car ready to drive with 50% fuel, 100% fluids)". Model page: "1360 kg Curb weight". Asphalte.ch: "Kerb weight is claimed at 1360kg with all fluids and half a tank of gas". Single configuration.

discrepancies.reason: Units: 1 MW is 1,341 hp or 1,360 PS; Koenigsegg labels the metric figure "hp".
discrepancies.resolution: Stored the kW rating converted at 1.34102 (1,341 hp), per the guide.

reviewNotes: Market: one of the 7 cars went to the US. Motor Authority (motorauthority-one1-us, Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 13 August 2015): "The One:1 in Monterey is the sole example destined for the United States." No evidence was found that the One:1 was federalised, EPA-certified or sold through a US dealer, and no US model year exists, so it is treated as a single private import and the record uses the home market (EU, calendar years). A human should confirm that choice. Power: stored as 1,341 hp, Koenigsegg's "1 MW" converted at 1.34102 per the guide; Koenigsegg's model page prints "1,360 hp", which is the metric (PS) figure. The existing Jesko and Agera R records store Koenigsegg's metric "hp" as published because no kW figure was available for them; a human should decide whether the three records should be made consistent.
